name: Sacred Geyser
description: A geyser of boiling water erupts at any character who attempts to take water from the oasis.
disable: DC 21 Thievery (trained) to concoct a mechanism for indirectly harvesting the water from a safe distance
reset: The geyser resets automatically and adapts to previous circumvention, requiring a new check to disable it each time.

generalAbilities.name: Sacred Geyser
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature dips a vessel or otherwise attempts to remove water from the oasis

Effect A jet of magical boiling water targets the triggering creature and affects all creatures within 5 feet of the target. Creatures caught in the burst take (2d10+13) Fire Damage (Basic DC 23 Reflex Saving Throw save).
